title: prepare crashes on empty tool call batches
reasoning: prepare accepts a list of parsed tool calls and logs the batch size, but any batch with length 0 falls into the single-call branch and indexes tool_calls[0]. That raises IndexError instead of returning an empty PreparationResult or a controlled validation error. If an upstream parser or retry path invokes preparation after filtering invalid/no-op calls, this becomes a hard agent-loop failure rather than a recoverable preparation result.
recommendation: Handle an empty tool_calls list before the bundle/single branch, returning PreparationResult(resolved_calls=[], errors=[]) or a deliberate preparation error consistent with caller expectations.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were provided for this feature, and the shown code has no guard or documented precondition covering empty batches.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a unit test that calls ToolPreparer.prepare([], session) and asserts it returns a controlled PreparationResult without raising IndexError.
minimumFixScope: Add an explicit empty-list branch in ToolPreparer.prepare and cover it with a focused backend preparation test.
